title: The Nihilist Reading Of Dororo #Shorts
description:
The feeling that Dororo means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. Dororo (どろろ) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Osamu Tezuka. Tezuka's childhood memory of his friends pronouncing dorobō (どろぼう; "thief") as dororo inspired the title of the series.

What culture calls destiny in Dororo is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. He was about a day behind Ojiya and Dororo, when she the first died in a red lily field.
